scope: Independent source-bound review of identity, research question, method, findings, limitations, literal quotations and controlled-category relevance. This receipt grants no human verification or publication authority.

findings.finding: The source identifies itself as a mini review using narrative synthesis after systematic searches in Scopus, Web of Science, Google Scholar, arXiv and SSRN during October to December 2025, with approximately 50 retained sources and thematic analysis across four domains. Calling it only a structured literature review and repeating the abstract-level summary omits the actual method and should be corrected.

The document supplies one general quotation and no concrete synthesis findings or source locators beyond that quotation. It needs source-grounded findings for the four review domains and explicit limitations before it can function as a complete preparation distillate.

The source supports Generative_KI, AI_Literacies, Bias_Ungleichheit, Gender, Diversitaet, Feministisch and Fairness through its intersectional framework, image-generation harms, gendered and racialized representation, Black feminist grounding, equity governance and fairness/accountability discussion. Category relevance does not cure the method and evidence omissions.
The source tables are available as linearised text, while figures were not independently inspected. Any revised document must preserve that boundary.
